article.title: Amid deepening financial crisis, UNRWA conducts mass layoffs in Gaza
article.author: Mohamed Solaimane
article.content: UNRWA says it is forced to cut services because it cannot cover a $70 million shortfall. But laid-off employees, its staff union, and its former spokesperson say the cuts are aimed at something broader: the refugee question itself.
